besluite.fout: 'rook reg te maak' is wooden: smoke is not something one 'fixes' in Afrikaans
besluite.rede: 'te keer' is the natural verb for stopping factory smoke and keeps the point that it is not the learner's job.

besluite.fout: 'blik' on its own can be read as a tin can, which is how the same list uses 'ou blikke' two items later
besluite.rede: 'vullisblik' removes the ambiguity, matches the list's last item and changes no meaning.

besluite.fout: missing AWS 2017 comma before 'want' joining two clauses that each have their own verb
besluite.rede: The imperative 'Moenie vullis brand nie' and 'die rook trek deur die hele straat' are two sentences, so the comma is required.

besluite.fout: the passive 'is later 'n hele week gemaak' is stiff
besluite.rede: 'het later 'n hele week geword' says the same thing naturally, in the same number of words, for a Grade 4 reader.

This is a glossary definition, and the reading the finder warns about (the gas taking up the trees) is too absurd to mislead anyone; the passive makes it longer and breaks the parallel with the 'suurstof' entry.
